referenceSources.title: Ferrari 348 Challenge Guide — Supercar Nostalgia
referenceSources.description:
A striking red Ferrari 348 Challenge is captured from behind on a racetrack, its wide rear tires planted firmly on the asphalt. The car’s distinctive slatted tail grille conceals rectangular taillights, while quad exhaust tips peek out from beneath the bumper. Sponsor decals for Pirelli, Agip, Speedline, and ANSA navimatic accent the lower bodywork, and the license plate MO 954041 sits centrally above a bold Pirelli logo.

This image highlights the 348 Challenge’s track-ready modifications: a bolt-in roll cage, racing seats, and a Challenge-spec exhaust box, all part of the factory upgrade kit introduced in 1992. The pressed steel monocoque chassis, transverse gearbox, and 3.4‑litre V8 engine combine to deliver 300 bhp at 7200 rpm. The setting—a closed circuit with grassy embankments—underscores the car’s purpose-built nature for one-make racing series held across Europe in the early 1990s.
